product.name: Premium
product.description: Get {count} AI chat messages per month and custom accent colors in Nibomo.
portal.headline: Manage your Nibomo Premium subscription
offer.title: Premium
offer.description: More AI chat messages and your own accent color.
offer.accentBenefit: Choose a preset or your own accent color.
offer.renewalDisclosure: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel. Manage or cancel it in Subscription settings.
offer.guestExplanation: Add an email to your account before subscribing so you can recover your access on another device.
offer.syncClarification: Sync is free on every plan.
limit.title: You've reached your monthly AI allowance
limit.freeExplanation: Premium gives you {count} AI chat messages per month.
limit.paidExplanation: Your monthly AI allowance resets on {date}.
ownKey.explanation: Using your own OpenAI key is available on every plan. It lets you use AI without spending your Nibomo allowance and does not unlock Premium features. OpenAI charges for that usage separately.
checkout.delayed: We're still confirming your subscription. Check its status before starting another checkout.
checkout.interrupted: Checkout was interrupted. Check your subscription status before trying again.
subscription.cancelledRenewal: Access continues until {date}. Your subscription will not renew.
subscription.paymentProblem: Your payment needs attention. Update your payment method to keep your subscription.
subscription.lifetimeWithSubscription: You have lifetime access and a separate subscription. You can manage that subscription below.
subscription.unknown: Your subscription status could not be confirmed. Check your connection and retry.
subscription.accountChanged: Your account changed. Open Subscription settings for your current account.
offer.taxDisclosure: The price shown includes applicable taxes.
offer.trialDisclosure: A payment method is required. After 7 days, you will be charged {price} per month unless you cancel before the trial ends.
offer.trialEligibility: One free trial per Stripe customer. A previous Apple or Google trial does not affect eligibility.
offer.allowanceWindow: Your AI message allowance resets each calendar month in UTC, independently of your billing date.
email.trialReminderSubject: Your Nibomo Premium trial ends soon
email.trialReminderBody: Your Nibomo Premium free trial ends on {date}. After the trial, your subscription renews automatically at a monthly base price of {price}, including applicable taxes. Stripe shows the final charge in your billing currency. To avoid the first charge, cancel before the trial ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in Subscription settings: {url}
email.paymentReceiptBody: Your payment of {price} was received. View your receipt: {url}
email.refundReceiptBody: Your refund of {price} was issued. View details: {url}
deletion.warning: Deleting your Nibomo account cancels future renewals of your Nibomo subscriptions billed through Stripe. You will lose access to this account. Subscriptions billed through Apple or Google must be canceled separately through that provider.
deletion.cancelling: Canceling your Stripe subscription renewals before deleting your account...
deletion.cancellationFailed: We couldn't confirm cancellation of your Stripe subscription renewals. Your account has not been deleted. Try again or contact support.
